text:
I put my dream on a ship

and the ship upon the sea,

—then I opened the sea with my hands,

to make it shipwreck.


My hands are still wet

with the blue of the half-open waves,

and the color draining from my fingers

colors the deserted sands.


From far away the wind comes,

and the night bends with cold,

under the water my dream is dying

inside a ship...


I will cry all that is necessary

to make the sea grow,

and for my ship to reach the bottom,

and my dream disappear.


Afterward, everything will be perfect;

smooth beach, calm waters,

my eyes dry as stones

and my two hands broken.

translation.title: Song
translation.editorial_note: This Song variant preserves the duplicate dream-ship poem and the final period present in this catalog record.
